catholic-encyclopedia-1913-berthold-schw: This 1913 reference piece on Berthold Schwarz — the legendary inventor of gunpowder. Henry Brock sifts fact from fable. The friar's name clings to the powder. The legend outruns the proof. The monk of the explosive myth. His mortar is the legend's proof.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-goerz: This 1913 reference piece on Goerz — Gorizia, the Austrian archdiocese. Gregor Reinhold gives its ancient story. Its archbishops guard the Isonzo's flock. The castle crowns the old town. A see of the Julian hills. Its 1751 archdiocese is famed.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-thomas-of-jor: Jorz was the cardinal of the Dominicans. This entry traces his 1200s, his England, and his Rome. The theologian of the Oxford schools: his brief cardinalate crowned Rome in the 1300s of the Boniface in the truly very old curia.
